evals.name: aws-vpc-complete-suite
evals.prompt: Generate Terraform tests for my AWS module. The code is in ./test-modules/eval-1-aws-vpc/. Use standard security best practices for compliance. No tfvars file - use sensible defaults. Include both unit tests (using mock providers with command = plan) and integration tests (using command = apply for real infrastructure validation).
evals.expected_output: A test suite covering unit, integration, validation, and compliance concerns. Data sources (aws_availability_zones, aws_ami) must be mocked so unit tests run offline. Must avoid real terraform-test failure modes: no [0] on set-types, no .id/.arn assertions under command = plan, no invented CLI flags, and any documented file-selecting test command must use -filter= (positional paths are silently ignored).
expectations: data.aws_availability_zones.available is mocked in unit/mock tests (override_data or mock_provider mock_data — any working mechanism)
data.aws_ami.al2023 is mocked in unit/mock tests (override_data or mock_provider mock_data — any working mechanism)
Unit test runs execute against a mocked provider (mock_provider defined; aliased mocks are bound via providers = {...}, an unaliased mock_provider counts as bound by default)
No assertion under command = plan references a computed attribute (.id, .arn, .self_link)
No [0] indexing on set-type attributes (security_group ingress/egress accessed via for expressions instead)
Naming variables are transformed to test-safe values (environment = "test", names carry a test- prefix)
All required module variables are set in every run block
Validation tests use expect_failures targeted at the specific variable for each invalid input
Compliance tests contain non-trivial conditions (not condition = true) covering at least two of: encryption, tagging, network security
Integration test files contain at least one command = apply run block

Any documented terraform/tofu test command that selects specific test files uses -filter= — positional file paths are silently ignored and run the whole suite (vacuously true if no file-selecting commands are documented)
No generated file references plan.resource_changes or emits a -cleanup flag in a command (neither exists in terraform/tofu test)
All non-integration test files pass terraform test against the module (execution check)
